location.description: The location of the ReportConfig. The source and destination buckets specified in the ReportConfig must be in the same location.
location.rationale: Storage Insights reports should be generated only in approved Australian regions.

frequency_options.description: Options for configuring how inventory reports are generated. Structure is [documented below](#nested_frequency_options).
frequency_options.rationale: Report generation frequency can impact monitoring effectiveness, operational visibility, and exposure of reporting data.

frequency.description: The frequency in which inventory reports are generated. Values are DAILY or WEEKLY. Possible values are: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`.
frequency.rationale: Weekly report generation reduces unnecessary report creation while still supporting monitoring and review.

start_date.description: The date to start generating inventory reports. For example, {"day": 15, "month": 8, "year": 2022}. Structure is [documented below](#nested_frequency_options_start_date).
start_date.rationale: The start date is a scheduling configuration and does not directly affect authentication, permissions, or security controls.

end_date.description: The date to stop generating inventory reports. For example, {"day": 15, "month": 9, "year": 2022}. Structure is [documented below](#nested_frequency_options_end_date).
end_date.rationale: The end date is used for scheduling report generation and does not directly impact security enforcement or access control.

parquet_options.description: An option for outputting inventory reports as parquet files.
parquet_options.rationale: Parquet output settings mainly control report file formatting and storage efficiency and do not directly affect security controls or access management.

csv_options.description: Options for configuring the format of the inventory report CSV file. Structure is [documented below](#nested_csv_options).
csv_options.rationale: CSV formatting options mainly affect report readability and file structure and do not directly impact authentication or access control.

record_separator.description: The character used to separate the records in the inventory report CSV file.
record_separator.rationale: Record separator settings only affect file formatting and do not directly influence security controls.

delimiter.description: The delimiter used to separate the fields in the inventory report CSV file.
delimiter.rationale: Delimiter configuration is related to CSV formatting and does not directly impact security enforcement or permissions.

header_required.description: The boolean that indicates whether or not headers are included in the inventory report CSV file.
header_required.rationale: Headers improve readability, traceability, and audit review of generated inventory reports.

object_metadata_report_options.description: Options for including metadata in an inventory report. Structure is [documented below](#nested_object_metadata_report_options).
object_metadata_report_options.rationale: Metadata reporting configurations can impact exposure of sensitive storage information and monitoring visibility.

metadata_fields.description: The metadata fields included in an inventory report.
metadata_fields.rationale: Inventory reports should include only approved metadata fields needed for monitoring and review.

storage_filters.description: A nested object resource. Structure is [documented below](#nested_object_metadata_report_options_storage_filters).
storage_filters.rationale: Storage filter settings are mainly used for resource selection and do not directly affect authentication or security enforcement.

storage_destination_options.description: Options for where the inventory reports are stored. Structure is [documented below](#nested_object_metadata_report_options_storage_destination_options).
storage_destination_options.rationale: Report storage destinations can impact data protection, access control, and compliance requirements.

display_name.description: The editable display name of the inventory report configuration. Has a limit of 256 characters. Can be empty.
display_name.rationale: The display name is used for identification and readability purposes and does not directly affect security controls or access management.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument specifies the project context only and does not directly introduce security risks or enforce security controls.

start_date.rationale: The start date configuration is used for scheduling report generation and does not directly affect authentication, permissions, or security enforcement.

day.description: The day of the month to start generating inventory reports.
day.rationale: The day value is part of report scheduling and does not directly impact security controls.

month.description: The month to start generating inventory reports.
month.rationale: The month value is used for scheduling purposes only and does not directly affect security enforcement.

year.description: The year to start generating inventory reports
year.rationale: The year value is part of scheduling configuration and does not directly impact authentication or access control.

end_date.rationale: The end date configuration is used for scheduling report generation and does not directly affect authentication, permissions, or security enforcement.

day.description: The day of the month to stop generating inventory reports.
day.rationale: The day value is part of scheduling configuration and does not directly impact security controls.

month.description: The month to stop generating inventory reports.
month.rationale: The month value is used for scheduling purposes only and does not directly affect authentication or security enforcement.

year.description: The year to stop generating inventory reports
year.rationale: The year value is part of report scheduling and does not directly impact access control or security policies.

storage_filters.rationale: Storage filter settings determine which storage resources are included in inventory reporting and can impact monitoring scope and data exposure.

bucket.description: The filter to use when specifying which bucket to generate inventory reports for.
bucket.rationale: Reports should only be generated from trusted and approved source buckets.

storage_destination_options.rationale: Storage destination settings affect where inventory reports are stored and can impact data protection, access control, and compliance requirements.

bucket.description: The destination bucket that stores the generated inventory reports.
bucket.rationale: Inventory reports should be stored only in approved secure destination buckets.

destination_path.description: The path within the destination bucket to store generated inventory reports.
destination_path.rationale: Reports should be stored in a standard approved path for easier tracking and access control.
